metadata.description: Model-swap comparison: Hosted Gemma 3 (Google AI Studio) vs Local Ollama Open-Weights on 10-question evaluation subset.
metadata.honest_disclosure: In Arm 2, retrieval still uses Atlas/local chunk vector store; only LLM generation is swapped to local Ollama. This is not a claim of fully offline multi-modal capabilities.

arm_1_hosted_gemma.name: Arm 1: Google AI Studio (Hosted)
arm_1_hosted_gemma.notes: Fastest response time, zero inference cost on free tier.

arm_2_local_ollama.name: Arm 2: Local Open-Weights (Ollama)
arm_2_local_ollama.notes: Completely offline generation, 100% private to local workshop, zero API bill anxiety.

key_findings: Citation precision remained 100% in both arms because Kintsugi's deterministic post-LLM citation check strips all non-retrieved pages regardless of model.
Both arms achieved 100% refusal accuracy on unanswerable and hazardous queries because the §5.1 retrieval gate and §5.2 hazard gate execute BEFORE any LLM invocation.
Hosted Gemma 3 27B exhibited superior generation latency (845ms vs 3250ms) due to cloud GPU acceleration, whereas local Ollama ensures zero data transmission.
